graph.title: Swamp Police Helicopter
notes: Piece order in steps 1-5 is ambiguous: the base is read as two 30157 pin plates side by side, bridged underneath by the 2x3 plate b2, with the two white 2x4 plates bridging both on top.
The pontoon (2x) is read as a round 2x2 pin-hole brick, then two round plates, then the robot-body brick, then the dome top. The step 9 pictures are not fully clear.
Each 30157 plate has a pin at each short end, so each pin goes into one pontoon's pin hole.
The catalogue omits top studs on 3040b, 3660 and 2479, and bottom anti-studs on 298c02, so those joins use null ports.
The exact stud positions for the blue bricks, levers, headlight assembly and slopes are best guesses from small pictures.
The headlight (48336 with two trans-yellow round tiles) is read as hanging from the front white clip plate (60470b) by its clips.
The tail (4488, 44661, 2421) is built on the 1x8 plate in step 13. The 1x8 plate sits on the two trans-dark-blue 1x1 plates from step 12.
The minifigure in step 16 is not in the parts list, so it is omitted.
